messages.en:
{07 04 00}Huh? {01 00 00 0a 00}But it looks like you
can't carry anything more,
can you?
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Maybe next time,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Mis? {01 00 00 0a 00}Aga tundub, et sa ei
suuda enam midagi kanda,
kas pole?
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Ehk järgmine kord,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
